item.content:encoded:
For the latest discoveries in cyber research for the week of 10th August, please download our Threat Intelligence Bulletin.

TOP ATTACKS AND BREACHES

  • North Carolina Ports, the US authority operating the ports of Wilmington and Morehead City, has suffered a cyberattack that forced some operations onto manual processes.
  • Ryde, an electric scooter operator in Scandinavia, has disclosed a data breach affecting customer accounts. Attackers copied phone numbers, email addresses and payment histories.

item.title: When Agentic Glue Melts: Cloudflare Code Mode
item.dc:creator: team
item.description: Check Point Research demonstrated that Cloudflare Code Mode inherited five vulnerabilities from the workerd runtime, enabling sandbox escape and cross-tenant data exposure.
